name: Scientists Load Extraterrestrial Coffin into Helicopter
description: Suited scientists move the coffin containing the dead extraterrestrial across the landing zone and secure it inside the Air Force helicopter. The helicopter's rotors begin to spin, lifting it off the ground shortly after the coffin is loaded.
related_events: Scientists load extraterrestrial's coffin into Air Force helicopter

name: Police Car Approaches on Dirt Road
description: The police car creeps up the dirt road between skeletons of unfinished houses, its parking lights the only illumination.
related_events: Police car approaches on dirt road using only parking lights

name: 18-Wheeler with Logs Passes By
description: An 18-wheeler loaded with logs moves slowly down the road, tires rumbling over the pavement as it passes the observers and continues on its way.
related_events: 18-wheeler carrying logs passes by

name: Figure Approaches Window and Looks Out
description: The humanoid figure crosses the room to a high window and looks out. The reddish tinge of the fog outlines his form.
related_events: Humanoid figure moves to high window and looks out

name: Jenny Drives the Mustang with STAR MAN
description: Jenny backs the Mustang out of the driveway, steering steadily as STAR MAN sits beside her, tense and quiet in the passenger seat.
related_events: Jenny drives Mustang out of driveway with STAR MAN as passenger

name: The Escaped Figure Rounds a Blind Corner
description: The escaped figure moves quickly, rounding a sharp, obscured turn in the environment.
related_events: Escaped figure banks around blind corner

name: Police Car Speeds Through Fog on Deserted Highway
description: A siren rises faintly in the distance. Through the fog, the dim glow of headlights and flashing blue lights appears, growing brighter as the police car emerges from the mist. It descends into a dip in the road, then reappears, racing down the center of the empty highway. The lights and siren swell as the vehicle draws near, then rushes past, fading rapidly into the fog behind.
related_events: Police car approaches and speeds past observers on deserted highway

name: Driver Steals Cigarette and Lights It
description: The driver carefully slips a cigarette from his sleeping partner's pocket, then reaches for the lighter. The wipers thud against the windshield as he brings the flame to the tip of the cigarette and takes a slow drag.
related_events: Driver attempts to steal cigarette from sleeping partner
Driver reaches for cigarette lighter

name: Squad Car Enters Pinewood Estates on Dirt Road
description: The squad car skids off the asphalt in front of a sign and turns onto a rutted dirt road. The sign indicates that the road leads into Pinewood Estates, a housing development financed by the Farmers Bank of Wisconsin. The vehicle moves forward, entering the property.
related_events: Squad car skids off asphalt onto dirt road

name: Security Guard Points Out Billboard Under Headlights
description: A security guard leans forward between two police officers, his hands gripping the seat fabric. He points through the windshield and speaks with a tremor in his voice, urging them to slow down. The headlights of the vehicle sweep across the road ahead, illuminating a billboard that announces a 'new' housing development.
related_events: Security guard alerts police officers to approaching location
Vehicle headlights illuminate housing development billboard

name: Silhouette Scans Kitchen with Cone of Light
description: A humanoid silhouette stands outside a picture window, faintly visible through the fog. As it moves into view, a sharp 'SNAP' echoes. From the darkness, a hard-edged cone of light bursts forward, illuminating the kitchen inside. The light sweeps across the stove, sink, cupboards, and electrical fixtures, capturing a detailed three-dimensional image of the room. The silhouette holds its hand at eye level, then slowly pulls the light back, taking the image with it.
related_events: Humanoid silhouette emits cone of light to scan kitchen interior

name: Second Officer Smells Smoke, Benny Responds
description: The windows of the vehicle are rolled down as the men ride. The Second Officer leans out periodically to get a clearer view of the surrounding terrain. At one point, he catches the smell of smoke in the air. Benny immediately responds, saying, "I told you."
related_events: Second Officer detects smell of smoke during vehicle travel
Benny asserts prior warning about smoke

name: Benny's Suggestion and the Officer's Response
description: The police officers grew tense as Benny fidgeted nervously in the back seat. He asked if they should call for backup. The officer replied that they could handle the situation without additional help.
related_events: Benny fidgets nervously in the back seat
Benny suggests calling for backup
Officer refuses to call for backup

name: Jenny Searches the Bathroom and Descends the Stairs
description: Jenny creeps toward the stairs in her stockinged feet. She opens the bathroom door and looks inside. The room is empty. She turns and begins to go downstairs.
related_events: Jenny creeps toward the stairs in stockinged feet
Jenny looks into the bathroom
Jenny decides to go downstairs

name: Driver Hits Figure on Road Despite Braking
description: The driver sees a figure in the headlights and immediately slams on the brakes. The truck skids forward, but the figure strikes the spoiler above the cab. The impact sends a boot crashing into the windshield, leaving a deep scratch across the glass.
related_events: Driver slams brakes after spotting figure in headlights
Figure collides with truck's cab spoiler
Figure's boot damages windshield during impact

name: Figure Crashes After Collision with Jack-Knifing Truck
description: The figure slams into a jack-knifing truck, bounces off, and tumbles through the air like a wounded bird. Spinning wildly, it plummets through tree branches and crashes face first into the mud at the bottom of an embankment. The strip lights along the sides of its helmet flicker and go dark.
related_events: Figure collides with jack-knifing truck and tumbles into trees
Figure crashes face first into muddy embankment
Helmet strip lights deactivate after impact

name: Driver and Partner Confront Unknown in the Woods
description: The driver and his partner stand in the shafts of the high beams cast by their vehicle, staring into the dark woods. The partner asks what the thing was. The driver replies that he has no idea.
related_events: Driver and partner peer into the woods from the vehicle's high beams
Partner questions the nature of an unknown phenomenon
Driver admits ignorance about the mysterious occurrence

name: The Star Man Awakens and Assesses His Condition
description: The Star Man stirs awake in the rain, his body lying on the ground. He quickly sits up and parts the tear in his suit, looking at his lung beneath the translucent skin. The organ has turned from brown to a deep yellow ocher. He takes several deep breaths, watching the lung expand and contract smoothly with each inhalation. After a moment, he runs his hands over the damaged sections of his spacesuit, checking the extent of the harm. Then, bracing himself, he pushes up onto his knees and slowly rises to his feet.
related_events: Star Man awakens suddenly in the rain
Star Man observes color change in his lung
Star Man tests his breathing in Earth's atmosphere
Star Man inspects his damaged spacesuit
Star Man rises to his feet from the ground

name: Fox and Team Watch Alien Autopsy
description: Fox, a civilian, and two men in uniform stand in a room lined with screens, watching a live video feed of an autopsy. On the screens, Dr. Bergen moves around a white glass table illuminated from below, where the body of an extraterrestrial lies. Bergen speaks to the camera, explaining that the creature has veins but no blood. He describes a complex brain and suggests that energy, rather than blood, circulates through the body. He adds that the alien’s biology is so different from human biology that there is likely no risk of bacterial contamination.
related_events: Fox and others observe autopsy via video feed
Dr. Bergen presents findings during extraterrestrial autopsy

name: Jenny Leaves in the Volvo
description: Jenny finishes saying goodbye, laughs, and waves as the Volvo reverses out of the driveway and drives away. She picks up her newspaper from the walkway and goes inside the house.
related_events: Jenny says goodbye before leaving in the Volvo
Volvo exits the driveway

name: Jenny Picks Up Newspaper and Goes Inside
description: After the Volvo backs out of the driveway and drives away, Jenny walks to the end of her walkway, picks up the newspaper, and goes into the house.
related_events: Jenny retrieves newspaper and enters house

name: Marc Shermin Surveys the Landing Site from Helicopter
description: A light rain falls as the helicopter moves through the gray sky, its nose tilting downward. Marc Shermin, a grizzled man in his mid-fifties, shifts his gaze from the right side of the craft to the left. Below, police cars block the road leading into the housing tract. The helicopter banks sharply, swinging around to reveal the blackened landing site. An orange nylon tent stands over the dead extraterrestrial, glowing faintly from within. On the far side of the burn, an Air Force helicopter sits parked on the ground.
related_events: Helicopter conducts aerial surveillance over extraterrestrial landing site
Police block road leading into housing tract
Orange nylon tent erected over dead extraterrestrial
Air Force helicopter lands near burn site
Helicopter performs banking turn to reveal landing site

name: Police Car Passes Dumpster with Glowing Light and Whistle
description: The police car drives past a road that intersects at a right angle. A short distance down that side road, a faint glow spills over the edges of an industrial dumpster. A high-pitched whistle echoes through the air. Then, a narrow shaft of light rises from inside the dumpster and moves upward, gliding between the houses before disappearing from view.
related_events: Police car drives past perpendicular road
Faint glow emerges from industrial dumpster
Eerie high-pitched whistle is heard near dumpster
Shaft of light rises from dumpster and flies between houses

name: The Figure Emerges and Signals for Rescue
description: A figure emerges from the fog at tree height, descending slowly as the high-pitched whistle of its rockets cuts through the air. From behind its faceplate, a burst of percussive sounds erupts. A subtitle appears: Lander four to Mapmaker Wind. Fix position for rescue. Repeat. Fix position for rescue.
related_events: Escaped figure emerges from fog at tree height
Rockets emit high-pitched whistle during descent
Figure transmits rescue request via percussive language
Subtitle displays rescue transmission from Lander four to Mapmaker Wind

name: Security Guard Turns Off Lights and Siren
description: The Security Guard wipes sweat from his brow, his face tense in the dim light. Without warning, he lunges forward and switches off the rack lights and siren. One of the Police Officers startles, saying, "Benny, God, take it easy..." The two officers glance at each other, sharing a brief, knowing look.
related_events: Security Guard wipes sweat from brow due to agitation
Security Guard deactivates rack lights and siren
Police Officer expresses concern over Security Guard's actions
Police Officers exchange indulgent look

name: Humanoid Figure Enters Kitchen and Receives Signal
description: The humanoid figure walks rapidly down the hall and enters the kitchen. An indistinct image flickers across the inside of its faceplate, and faint percussive sounds emanate from it. Through the window over the sink, the lights of the spaceship are visible. The rockets flip into the humanoid's gloved hands, and it leaps airborne, exiting through the open back door.
related_events: Humanoid figure enters kitchen after walking down hall
Percussive language sounds emitted from humanoid's faceplate

name: Humanoid Catches Rockets and Flies Out Back Door
description: The humanoid figure walks swiftly through the hall into the kitchen. Faint percussive sounds echo from its faceplate, where a shifting image flickers. Through the window over the sink, the lights of a spaceship glow in the distance. The rockets flip through the air and land in the figure's gloved hands. It rises immediately, lifting off the ground, and moves through the open back door into the night.
related_events: Humanoid figure catches rockets and becomes airborne
Humanoid figure exits building through back door

name: Benny and the Officer Move Toward the Hillside Light
description: The fires on the hillside burst back to life. Benny and the officer, trembling, push themselves to their feet and begin walking toward a column of light rising from a figure lying on the slope. The only sound comes from the police radio, crackling with urgent voices inside the open squad car.
related_events: Fires on the hillside reignite
Benny and the officer stand up and move toward the light

name: Radio Chatter from the Squad Car
description: The squad car stands open, its radio crackling with ongoing police chatter. The voice from the speaker fills the air, the only sound breaking the stillness around the hillside where Benny and the officer begin to rise. The glow from the radio's display flickers faintly in the dark, casting sharp edges on the ground nearby.
related_events: Police radio emits chatter from the open squad car

name: The Star Man Fights to Seal His Suit
description: The figure rolls onto its back, clawing at a jagged tear that runs from shoulder to hip in its life-support suit. Inside the helmet, a faint identification light flickers, illuminating the alien's translucent coral skin, hairless head, and black pupilless eyes veiled by transparent eyelids. Chalk-white lips part as the Man from the Stars gasps, struggling to breathe as Earth's air seeps into his suit. He reaches for the edges of the rip, trying to press them together, but his hands tremble and fall away, too weak to close the gash. The suit gapes open, exposing the network of veins and arteries beneath his translucent skin. Behind the faceplate, a shard of white light detaches from the glowing mass in his head and travels down his neck. Through the tear, the light reaches the top of his single lung and spreads through it like a rising tide of phosphorescence. His body goes still. The sound of a truck engine fades into the distance.
related_events: Identification light in helmet reveals alien's physical features
Alien experiences respiratory distress due to atmospheric mixing
Man from the stars struggles to seal tear in life-support suit

name: The Light Reaches the Lung
description: A piece of white light breaks away from the shining mass inside the Star Man's head and moves down his neck. It passes through the tear in his suit and enters his lung. The light spreads through the organ like a glowing tide. The Star Man's body goes still, and he slips into unconsciousness as the sound of the truck fading into the distance fills the air.
related_events: White light fragment travels from Star Man's head to his lung
Star Man loses consciousness after light spreads through lung

name: Dr. Bergen Conducts Autopsy on Extraterrestrial Body in Houston
description: In a laboratory in Houston, Dr. Bergen examines the body of an extraterrestrial being. He notes that the flesh is gelatinous and the skin is porous and moist. As he works, he offers his observations, suggesting the creature may have come from a planet that receives only reflected light, possibly from a ring of moons, and that its home atmosphere likely has higher water content and slightly lower pressure than Earth's. Through a communication link, George Fox in Washington asks why the beings have come. Dr. Bergen pauses, then admits he does not know their purpose, only that they are highly advanced—potentially dangerous, yet possibly the most significant event in human history. The crew observing the procedure react in silence, their expressions uncertain.
related_events: Dr. Bergen describes alien corpse's physical characteristics during autopsy
Dr. Bergen expresses uncertainty about extraterrestrial intentions during interview
related_occasions: Autopsy Of Extraterrestrial Body In Houston

name: Shermin and Crew Watch Autopsy Broadcast
description: Shermin and his crew stand in silence, eyes fixed on the monitors relaying the autopsy from Houston. Dr. Bergen's voice comes through, describing the creature's gelatinous flesh, porous skin, and likely origin on a world bathed in reflected light. He speaks of its advanced nature, the uncertainty of its intentions—how it could be dangerous, or the greatest event in human history. The crew exchanges glances, some tense, others thoughtful, their faces showing doubt, awe, and unease.
related_events: Shermin and autopsy crew react with mixed emotions to Dr. Bergen's assessment
related_occasions: Autopsy Of Extraterrestrial Body In Houston

name: Survey the Crash Site at Dawn
description: Hooded figures and Major Bell walk across the crash site as dawn breaks. They pass three scientists in suits who are scanning the ground with geiger counters and other instruments. The growing light of morning, combined with Bell's handlight, reveals deep indentations in the soil where pods had rested and a wide stretch of earth turned into a smooth, black glass cup. The glassed area glistens faintly, formed by intense heat radiating from the spacecraft's power plant.
related_events: Hooded figures and Bell move past scientists examining landscape
Dawn and Bell's handlight reveal pod indentations and fused earth

name: Bell Reports Witness Accounts and Confirms Alien Presence
description: After filing his report, Major Bell speaks with three local individuals who insist that another extraterrestrial did not board the ship and may still be in the area. He relays this information to Shermin near the site at dawn, where the scorched landscape and pod indentations are now visible in the light. A dead extraterrestrial lies in a nearby tent. Bell states firmly that the evidence is undeniable—that contact has occurred—and stresses that Washington needs to acknowledge it and begin preparing a response.
related_events: Bell reports and interviews three local individuals
Bell asserts the reality of extraterrestrial visitation based on evidence

name: Shermin Arrives and Meets Major Bell
description: An unmarked S65 helicopter descends and settles in the clearing. The nose door opens, and Shermin steps out, carrying the hood of his contamination suit. As he comes down the ladder, a tall man in a hoodless contamination suit approaches him. The man, holding a cigarette in his mouth, introduces himself as Major Aaron Bell. Shermin identifies himself as Marc Shermin from the National Security Agency. The two stand together as Shermin takes in the sight of the tent, the green hillside, and the forest beyond, bathed in the soft light of dawn.
related_events: Shermin's helicopter lands in clearing
Shermin disembarks from helicopter carrying contamination suit hood
Major Aaron Bell greets Shermin upon arrival

name: Shermin and Bell Investigate Contamination Risks
description: Shermin asked Major Bell if there were any signs of biological contamination or excessive radiation in the area. Bell replied that the landscape showed nothing, but they were trying to get a biological reading through the faceplate of a suit, though it was proving difficult. Bell lit a cigarette with shaking hands, the old one still in his mouth, and then flicked it away as he began pulling on his contamination hood. Shermin watched him, then followed as Bell started walking toward the tent.
related_events: Major Aaron Bell attempts to obtain biological reading through faceplate

name: Dr. Bergen Examines the Creature's Injuries
description: Dr. Bergen stands beside the creature, a tall, thin man in his late fifties, balding, dressed in a medical contamination suit. He activates a laser light indicator and points it at the creature’s body, tracing three distinct impact sites. The first mark appears on the arm, the second on the abdomen, and the third on the upper chest. He notes that the chest wound proved fatal, having shattered the creature’s backbone-like structure—a hollow, pliable shaft made of silicate material, not jointed like a human spine, but serving a similar function. Despite the creature’s quick death, the wounds on the arm and abdomen show significant healing, the tissue nearly closed. The laser sweeps back to the chest, where the embedded projectile is visibly dissolving within the surrounding material.
related_events: Dr. Bergen presents cause of death using laser indicator
Dr. Bergen observes regenerative healing in creature's wounds

name: Dr. Bergen Examines the Creature's Endoskeleton and Bullet Dissolution
description: Dr. Bergen stands beside the creature, a laser light in hand, tracing the points where it was struck. He directs the beam to the chest wound, explaining that the injury shattered the creature's backbone. He clarifies that the structure is not a spine in the human sense, but a hollow, flexible shaft made of silicate material, which forms the entirety of its internal skeleton. The material is pliable and lacks joints. He notes that despite the fatal damage, the wounds on the arm and abdomen have nearly closed. As he moves the laser to the chest wound again, he points out that the bullet embedded there has started to break down, its surface eroding within the creature's tissue.
related_events: Dr. Bergen describes creature's endoskeleton composition
Dr. Bergen identifies bullet dissolution in creature's tissue

name: Star Man Sends Message with Glowing Marble
description: The sun set over suburban Eau Claire, casting reflections on Star Man's faceplate as he watched Jenny push a hand mower across her backyard. After she finished and began dumping grass clippings into a garbage can, Star Man took a dusty gray marble from a leg pocket. He rolled it between his gloves, and the marble turned golden, growing to the size of a baseball. Holding it close to his faceplate, he spoke into it, saying, 'Iron channel message. Suit and rockets destroyed. Radical mixture of this atmosphere and ours in helmet allowed chemo-ion response time to adapt my body to this air. Am going to attempt extreme transformation in order to cross land mass to site of our practice landings. If transformation is not fatal, second message ball by next darkness.' He opened his hands, and the marble rose quickly into the sky. The sudden movement caught Jenny’s eye, and she watched it quizzically until it disappeared from view.
related_events: Star Man observes Jenny mowing her backyard lawn
Star Man activates a glowing message marble
Star Man records a message into the activated marble
Star Man releases the message marble into the sky

name: Jenny Sees the Glowing Marble Rise
description: Jenny walks to the side of the house and empties the grass clippings into a garbage can. As she does, a sudden movement in the sky catches her eye. She looks up and sees a glowing golden marble ascending quickly. It grows smaller as it climbs, and she watches it with quiet puzzlement until it disappears from view.
related_events: Jenny notices the message marble ascending

name: Star Man Prepares for Transformation
description: The sun sets over suburban Eau Claire, casting reflections on STAR MAN's faceplate as he watches Jenny push a hand mower across her backyard. He retrieves a dusty gray marble from a leg pocket and rolls it between his gloves. The marble glows gold and grows, expanding to the size of a baseball. Holding it close to his faceplate, he speaks into it. A subtitle reads: 'Iron channel message. Suit and rockets destroyed. Radical mixture of this atmosphere and ours in helmet allowed chemo-ion response time to adapt my body to this air. Am going to attempt extreme transformation in order to cross land mass to site of our practice landings. If transformation is not fatal, second message ball by next darkness.' He opens his hands, and the glowing ball rises swiftly into the sky. Jenny, dumping grass clippings into a garbage can at the side of the house, notices the sudden movement above her. She looks up, watches the object with curiosity until it vanishes from view.
related_events: Star Man prepares for extreme transformation to cross land mass

name: Star Man Observes the Town from the Tree Line
description: The morning rain has stopped. The STAR MAN, still in his life-support suit, moves through the canopy of firs as twilight fills the forest. He follows the hum of traffic to a stand of alders bordering the woods, where he sees a highway cutting toward the sprawl of Eau Claire, Wisconsin. Cars and trucks speed along the asphalt, drawing his attention. He watches them for a time, then walks deeper through the trees for a clearer view of the town. To his right, the voices of students rise on the wind as they board a line of yellow buses outside a grade school. Suburban houses cluster at the base of the hill. Staying within the cover of the tree line, he continues along the ridge. Below, a Volvo station wagon turns into a driveway and stops beside a Mustang Hatchback. The back door opens, and JENNY HAYDN, a young woman in her mid-twenties, steps out holding a decorated sign that reads 'Welcome Back, Mrs. Haydn.' From inside the car, female voices call out, 'It was great to have you back... The kids loved it. We loved it. You're doing the right thing...'
related_events: Morning rain ceases in the forested area
STAR MAN observes highway traffic near Eau Claire
STAR MAN hears students boarding school buses
STAR MAN moves through forest to observe the town

name: Star Man Observes Jenny Haydn's Return Home
description: The STAR MAN watches as a Volvo station wagon pulls into the driveway of a suburban house below him. Jenny Haydn opens the back door and steps out, holding a hand-decorated sign adorned with ribbons that reads 'Welcome Back, Mrs. Haydn.' Voices from inside the car call out, saying it was great to have her back, that the kids loved it, and that she is making the right choice. The STAR MAN remains still, observing the exchange as the car doors close and the vehicle idles in the driveway.
related_events: Star Man observes Volvo station wagon arriving at suburban house
Jenny Haydn exits car with welcome sign
Female passengers express joy at Mrs. Haydn's return

name: STAR MAN watches a plane overhead
description: The STAR MAN moves through the trees and stops when he sees a light plane flying above. He watches it as it passes, until the branches block his view.
related_events: STAR MAN observes a light plane flying overhead

name: STAR MAN Reaches the Promontory
description: The STAR MAN follows a narrow path between two logs and reaches the tip of a promontory. From there, he sits behind the cedars and looks down on the center of Eau Claire.
related_events: STAR MAN reaches the tip of a promontory

name: STAR MAN Watches the Young Couple Pass By
description: The STAR MAN crouches in a thicket of small pines, hidden behind cedars. Below him, a young couple walks through the trees, arms linked. The boy carries a blanket over his shoulder; the girl's hair is disheveled. They pass close to his hiding place without seeing him. After they go by, he stands and watches them continue down the path toward the highway.
related_events: STAR MAN observes a YOUNG COUPLE walking through the trees
YOUNG COUPLE walks past STAR MAN toward the highway
STAR MAN stands and continues watching the YOUNG COUPLE

name: Star Man Calls to Mapmaker Wind
description: Star Man stands still, his mirrored faceplate reflecting the dim light. From behind it, a series of percussive sounds emerge. He speaks: 'Mapmaker Wind. Do you hear me?' Only a low buzz answers. He taps several buttons on his chest panel, then repeats the same words. Again, the buzz. He tries a third time—'Mapmaker Wind. Do you hear me?'—but the response does not change.
related_events: Star Man attempts to establish communication with Mapmaker Wind
Star Man activates chest panel controls

name: Star Man Projects Map with Location Markers
description: Star Man pressed the palms of his hands together, then slowly pulled them apart, creating a blue force field that stretched between them. As he held his hands shoulder-width apart, a solarized aerial view of the United States appeared on the surface of the field. A green dot emerged over western Wisconsin, and another dot, red in color, appeared in the region of Death Valley, California. He remained still, observing the image floating in front of him. After a long moment, he reached forward, closed his hands around the projection, and extinguished it as the light vanished between his palms.
related_events: Star Man creates blue force field with hands
Solarized aerial map of United States appears on force field
Green and red dots appear on map indicating locations

name: Star Man Dismisses the Floating Compass
description: The solarized aerial view of the United States hovered in the air in front of Star Man. After a long silence, he reached up with both hands, grasped the edges of the glowing display, and pulled it inward. The image folded into itself as he squeezed it between his palms, compressing it into a small, bright sphere. When his hands came fully together, the light vanished, leaving nothing in the air before him.
related_events: Star Man dismisses floating compass by squeezing it into a ball

name: Star Man Adjusts His Appearance in the Mirror
description: The Star Man steps into the room and moves to the mirror fastened to the back of the closet door. He notices the buttons on his plaid shirt are misaligned, with one in the wrong hole, and uses his new hands to awkwardly rebutton the fabric. He watches his movements in the glass, then turns his attention to his face. He pinches the skin on his cheeks, peers closely at his eyes, turns his head to examine the sides of his face, folds his ears forward to inspect the skin behind them, and pulls firmly on his hair with both hands to test its hold. Satisfied, he steps away from the mirror and walks to the bed, where he picks up a .45 and a leg pouch from his life-support suit. Next to them lies a photograph of a man dressed exactly as he is now. He speaks to Jenny in his own language and gestures toward the door. When she does not move, he approaches, grabs her arm, and pulls her to her feet before leading her out of the room.
related_events: Star Man adjusts misaligned shirt buttons with new hands
Star Man observes and evaluates his human-like movements
Star Man inspects facial features in mirror for authenticity

name: Star Man Takes the Gun and Calls Jenny
description: The Star Man turns from the mirror and walks to the bed where the .45 and a leg pouch from his life-support suit rest beside a photograph of the man whose identity he now wears. He picks up the gun and the pouch. Speaking to Jenny in his own language, he steps toward the door and motions for her to follow.
related_events: Star Man picks up .45 gun and leg pouch from bed
Star Man speaks to Jenny in his native language

name: Star Man drags Jenny from the room
description: Jenny sits on the floor, ignoring the Star Man as he motions for her to follow. He steps toward her, reaches down, and grabs her arm, pulling her to her feet. She squirms, trying to pull away, but he holds her tightly. She looks at his hand, then up at his face—familiar, yet unsettling. 'Don’t… don’t do this… please…' she pleads. He doesn’t respond, forcing her upright and guiding her toward the door. As they leave, the wedding photo on the dresser shows the man he now resembles.
related_events: Star Man grabs Jenny's arm to pull her to her feet
Jenny resists being pulled by Star Man
Jenny looks at Star Man's hand and then his face with distress
Jenny pleads with Star Man to stop
Star Man forces Jenny to her feet and leads her out of the room

name: Star Man Pulls Jenny Downstairs and to the Entryway
description: The Star Man grabs Jenny and pulls her down the stairs. She struggles to break free, twisting and resisting as he drags her forward. He guides her into the entryway and reaches for the front door.
related_events: Star Man pulls Jenny down the stairs
Jenny struggles to free herself from Star Man
Star Man guides Jenny into entryway and reaches for front door

name: Jenny Resists the Star Man at the Front Door
description: The Star Man pulls Jenny down the stairs and guides her into the entryway. She struggles to free herself, crying out that he is hurting her and demanding he stop. As he reaches for the front door, Jenny realizes his intention and pulls away, refusing to go outside. She backs away, sobbing, saying she can't leave with him and that she's afraid. The Star Man opens the door, taps his chest, points at her, and gestures toward the dawn. Jenny pleads, saying she wants to help but knows he isn’t Scott and doesn’t know what he is. She remains afraid. The Star Man closes the door, then raises the gun, looks at it briefly, and points it at her. He swings the muzzle across her body and fires. A floor vase shatters. Jenny looks at the broken pieces, then back at the Star Man.
related_events: Jenny breaks away from Star Man in resistance
Jenny expresses fear and emotional conflict toward Star Man
Star Man opens front door and gestures toward dawn

name: Star Man Traps Jenny and Fires Warning Shot
description: Jenny backs into the living room as the Star Man closes the front door. He raises a gun, looks at her, and points it directly at her. Jenny pleads with him, her voice trembling, saying she’s afraid and that he looks like Scott but she knows he’s not him. Without speaking, the Star Man moves the gun slightly and fires. The bullet hits a floor vase, shattering it. Jenny flinches, staring at the broken pieces, then back at the Star Man, who remains still, the gun now lowered but still in his hand.
related_events: Star Man closes front door and points gun at Jenny
Jenny pleads with Star Man during confrontation
Star Man fires gun near Jenny as warning

name: Jenny Breaks Down, Refusing to Leave with the Star Man
description: Jenny backs away into the living room, tears streaming down her face. She pleads with the Star Man, saying she can't go with him, that she's afraid. She tells him he looks like Scott, but she knows he’s not Scott, and she doesn’t know what he is. Her voice trembles as she says she wants to help, but she can’t because of her fear. The Star Man stands silently, then closes the front door behind him.
related_events: Jenny expresses fear and emotional conflict toward Star Man

name: Police Car Arrives and Forces Evasive Move
description: Mike speeds up the dirt road in the police car, its lights flashing. The car fishtails and slides sideways, coming to a sudden, jarring stop next to Benny and the officer. They leap out of the way just in time to avoid being struck.
related_events: Police car fishtails up dirt road and stops abruptly
Benny and officer jump aside as police car stops

name: Benny and Officer Confront Light Beam from Humanoid Figure
description: After the police car skids to a stop, Benny and the officer stumble out and find themselves directly in the path of an intense white beam shining from the humanoid figure. The light cuts through the fog, and with the spacecraft rising at a steep angle, the beam appears to be aimed straight at them. The officer, overwhelmed, fires his shotgun into the fog. The figure veers away and vanishes. The spacecraft roars upward, climbing rapidly into the night sky, its force blasting a shockwave that throws both men to the ground.
related_events: Group faces intense white beam from humanoid figure
Light beam appears to target group due to approach angle

name: Officer Shoots at the Figure and It Disappears
description: The officer, trembling, raised his shotgun and fired wildly at the humanoid figure. The blasts echoed through the clearing as the figure suddenly veered to the side and vanished into the thick fog. The beam of light it had been emitting cut off midair, leaving only silence in its wake.
related_events: Officer fires shotgun wildly at humanoid figure in terror
Humanoid figure veers off and disappears into the fog

name: Spacecraft Rises and Knocks Benny and the Officers Down
description: The spacecraft rose above the trees, its power plant roaring as it climbed into the night sky. With a sudden, thunderous burst, it shot upward at tremendous speed. The force of its ascent sent powerful shockwaves rippling across the ground, slamming into Benny and the officers and knocking them off their feet.
related_events: Spacecraft begins to rise above the tree line with loud noise
Spacecraft reaches escape velocity and ascends into the night sky
Concussion waves from spacecraft launch knock Benny and officers down

name: Humanoid Figure Returns to the Spacecraft
description: The humanoid figure emerges from the house and streaks across the sky, flying between the trees toward the hovering spacecraft. It ascends into the intense white beam of light extending from the ship's underbelly. The beam retracts, and the figure vanishes inside as the spacecraft begins to rise.
related_events: Humanoid figure flies into spacecraft underbelly beam

name: Jenny's Attempt to Escape
description: Jenny notices the Star Man is not in the living room. She edges along the wall, moving carefully toward the front door.
related_events: Jenny moves cautiously toward the front door

name: Jenny Confronts the Star Man in the Den
description: Jenny stops at the archway to the den when a hissing sound cuts through the silence. She peers around the molding into the dimly lit room, where the spill of stairwell light reveals the Star Man sitting on the edge of a chair, naked, his back to her. A small dot of light moves steadily across the top of his translucent head, reshaping its surface. Holding a .45 in front of her, Jenny steps into the room, her footfall causing the floor to creak. The Star Man turns toward her, and she sees clearly what he is doing.
related_events: Hissing sound halts Jenny's movement
Jenny observes the STAR MAN in the den
Jenny enters the den with gun drawn

name: Jenny Sees the Photograph and Breaks Down
description: The Star Man turns to face Jenny. He is holding an 8x10 color photograph of Jenny and a man in his mid-twenties standing on a beach in their bathing suits. Jenny recognizes the image. Her hands tremble, and she lowers the gun. She sags against the armchair, overcome with sobs.
related_events: STAR MAN turns to face Jenny
Jenny recognizes photograph of herself and a man on the beach
Jenny lowers her weapon and collapses emotionally

name: Star Man Takes the Gun and Completes His Transformation
description: The Star Man gently took the gun from Jenny’s hands and set it down on the couch. Without speaking, he returned to the photograph lying in his lap. The dot of light flickered back to life, tracing the contours of the man’s face in the image. It moved across his cheek, down to the jawline, and finished shaping the chin. The transformation spread beyond the face, weaving a layer of human skin over his torso and limbs, until his entire body resembled the man in the photograph.
related_events: Star Man retrieves gun from Jenny and places it on the couch
STAR MAN undergoes facial transformation
Star Man resumes and continues facial and bodily transformation

name: Helicopter Hovers Over the House
description: The flapping of a helicopter grows louder, approaching the house and drowning out Jenny's sobs. It moves into position directly above the house, its searchlight sweeping across the hillside behind the yard. The beam cuts through the darkness, illuminating the ground outside the windows.
related_events: Helicopter approaches the location
Helicopter hovers directly over the house with searchlight active

name: Police Arrive and Spot Fires on the Hill
description: The police car rounds a curve on the hillside and comes to a stop. Benny points urgently toward the next hill, where a necklace of embers and a burning tree flicker through the fog. The officer steps forward, straining to see through the thickening mist. Benny insists the lights are there, visible in line with the burning tree, and says they came from a ship and moved toward the houses. The officer remains skeptical, suggesting it might be kids. Meanwhile, the second officer, Mike, notices something below—a beam of light bobbing among the houses. Another light, further in, shifts slightly before holding still. One of the lights rises over a house and disappears on the other side. Mike remains unconvinced by the officer's explanation.
related_events: Police car stops on hillside after rounding a curve
Benny points out embers and burning tree on adjacent hill
Officer steps forward for clearer view through fog

name: Benny Points to the Hill and Describes the Fires
description: The police car rounds a curve on the hillside and comes to a stop. Above, a line of embers from a grass fire and a burning tree glimmers through the fog. Benny leans forward, pointing urgently. "There!! Up on the hill!!" The first officer steps ahead for a clearer view. "Right in line with that burning tree," Benny says. "It's there. The fog's thicker now, but it's there." The officer squints but shakes his head. "Benny, there's nothing there." Benny insists, "They came out of the belly of the ship and then went to the first terrace and flew down into the houses." The officer scoffs, "Flew?! Oh, come on Benny..." Meanwhile, the second officer, Mike, stares intently at the houses below. "You hear that, Mike? Now he's telling us—" Mike interrupts, "What's that?" He points. A beam of light bobs among the houses. Further in, another light shifts slightly before going still. "What did I tell you?" Benny says. The first officer mutters, "Probably kids." One of the lights rises over a rooftop and disappears on the other side. Mike watches, unconvinced.
related_events: Benny describes origin of fires involving ship and terraces
Officer dismisses lights as likely caused by kids

name: Mike Spots Moving Lights Among the Houses
description: The officers stood on the hillside, the fog thickening around them. Mike, the second officer, fixed his gaze on the row of houses below. 'What's that?' he said, pointing. A bobbing beam of light moved among the structures, like a headlight weaving through the dark. Further in, another light shifted slightly from side to side but remained in place. Benny tightened his grip on the first officer's shoulder. 'What did I tell you?' he whispered. The first officer squinted. 'Probably kids,' he said. Then, one of the lights lifted over the roof of a house and dropped down on the far side, vanishing from view. Mike said nothing, his eyes still locked on the spot. Benny nodded, his voice low but insistent. 'They're moving. I told you they were there.'
related_events: Second officer focuses attention on activity among the houses
Mike points out moving headlight beam among the houses
One of the lights rises over a house and settles on the other side
Benny insists on significance of observed lights

name: Mike Questions the Lights
description: After the officer suggests the moving lights are just kids, Mike remains silent for a moment, his eyes fixed on the beams below. One light rises over a house and disappears on the other side. He frowns, then mutters, 'Probably...' without conviction, his gaze still locked on the spot where the light vanished.
related_events: Mike expresses skepticism about officer's explanation

name: Bell and Shermin Examine the Alien Body
description: Bell and Shermin enter the containment area where a slow-speed drill hums near the alien body. The extraterrestrial lies on its back, helmet lights shining upward, a hose sealed to the faceplate from a portable gas chromatograph. A foam-lined, coffin-shaped metal box rests against the wall. As they approach, Shermin looks into the faceplate but sees only his own reflection. He takes Bell’s flashlight, angles the beam across the surface, and leans in to follow the light. The drill’s pitch rises, then suddenly breaks through the faceplate, which explodes outward. The men recoil. When they look back, distorted reflections of the face inside the helmet shimmer on the glass of their contamination hoods. Bell moves toward the body. “We better get it into the box,” he says. The others start forward, but stop as a burst of sharp, percussive sounds followed by a low buzz emerges from within the helmet. Another burst rings out, and a beam shoots from the helmet, projecting the image of the escaped STAR MAN onto one of the scientists. He jerks away, and the image blurs across the tent wall. A subtitle appears: Mapmaker Wind. Do you hear me? Shermin whispers, “The other one is alive!”
related_events: Bell and Shermin approach the extraterrestrial body
Shermin observes reflection in alien faceplate
Shermin uses flashlight to examine alien faceplate

name: Scientists Analyze Alien Helmet as Bell and Shermin Watch
description: Bell and Shermin enter the tent to the sound of a slow-speed drill. An alien lies on its back, helmet lights shining upward, a hose sealed to the faceplate and connected to a portable gas chromatograph. One scientist adjusts the machine while another guides the drill into the faceplate, both wearing contamination suits. A foam-lined, coffin-shaped metal box rests nearby. Bell directs Shermin’s attention to the alien’s hands—three fingers and a thumb. Shermin takes Bell’s flashlight, angles it at the faceplate, and leans in. The drill’s pitch rises, then suddenly breaks through. The faceplate explodes outward, sending the men stumbling back. As they recover, distorted reflections of the alien’s face shimmer inside the helmet’s remains. A burst of sharp, percussive sounds followed by a low buzz emerges from within. The group freezes. Another burst of sound erupts, and a beam of light shoots from the helmet, projecting the image of the escaped STAR MAN onto one of the scientists. He flinches away, and the image blurs across the tent wall. A voice follows: 'Mapmaker Wind. Do you hear me?' Shermin whispers, 'The other one is alive!'
related_events: Scientists conduct drilling and gas analysis on alien helmet
Drill breaks through alien faceplate causing sudden explosion

name: Breaching the Helmet and Containment Response
description: The drill bit broke through the alien's faceplate, and the panel suddenly exploded outward. The men flinched back, shielding themselves. As they cautiously turned back, the distorted reflections of the alien's face shimmered inside the helmet's curved surface. Major Bell stepped forward and said, 'We better get it into the box. Come on...' The others began moving toward the body. Just as they approached, a burst of sharp, percussive sounds followed by a low hum came from within the helmet. They froze. Another burst of sounds erupted, and a beam of light shot out, projecting the image of the escaped STAR MAN onto one of the scientists. He jerked away, and the image wavered, losing focus against the tent wall behind him. A subtitle appeared: Mapmaker Wind. Do you hear me? Shermin whispered, 'The other one is alive!'
related_events: Drill breaks through alien faceplate causing sudden explosion
Bell directs team to place alien body into containment box

name: The Helmet Comes Alive
description: After the drill broke through the faceplate, a sudden burst of sharp, percussive sounds followed by a low buzz emerged from the alien's helmet, causing the team to freeze. A moment later, a projection beam shot out from inside the helmet, casting the image of the escaped STAR MAN onto one of the scientists. He flinched and jumped aside, breaking the projection, which then scattered and blurred across the tent wall behind him. Shermin stared, then whispered in disbelief, 'The other one is alive!'
related_events: Extraterrestrial helmet emits burst of percussive language and low buzz
Projection beam from alien helmet displays image of escaped STAR MAN
Scientist reacts to projection by jumping aside
Shermin exclaims that the other alien is alive

name: Advance Toward the Light
description: The officer led Benny and Mike across the dirt road, their guns drawn as they moved through the tract toward the last place they had seen a flickering light. The officer signaled for Benny and Mike to spread out, taking positions on either side. A police searchlight swept across the house, casting sharp shadows through the unfinished frames of the buildings. Over the outside speakers, the officer's voice rang out: 'This is the police. Identify yourselves.' Only silence answered. The fog thickened, swallowing sound and sight, as they pressed forward, the crunch of their footsteps and their own breath the only signs they weren’t alone.
related_events: Benny, Mike, and officer advance through the tract with guns drawn
Officer signals Benny and Mike to flank the house
Police searchlight illuminates the house
Officer issues police announcement via external speakers

name: Benny Spots a Light and Fires in the Fog
description: The police car remains parked on the dirt road as Benny and the officers watch a flickering light moving through the houses toward the fire on the hill. The police searchlight sweeps across the area, briefly illuminating the house. Over the speakers, an officer demands identification, but only silence answers. Carrying a shotgun, one officer signals for Benny and Mike to spread out. They move cautiously across the tract, the fog swallowing sound and sight, each step loud in the stillness. They lose sight of one another in the haze. Benny freezes when he hears a sharp whistle to his left. Slowly turning, he peers through the skeletal frame of an unfinished house and sees a beam of white light aimed at a cement mixer. He calls out to the officers, voice cracking. 'There's one over here...' The searchlight swings toward him. Hands trembling, Benny raises his gun. 'Stop!! Police!!' The light locks onto him. Startled, he fires two shots. The light cuts out. 'What happened?' Mike calls. 'I think I shot one,' Benny answers. 'Jesus, Benny. What are you doing?'
related_events: Benny hears a high-pitched whistle from his left
Benny spots a beam of light pointing at a cement mixer through an unfinished house
Benny calls out to officers about a suspect presence

name: Benny Fires at the Searchlight
description: The police searchlight swung toward Benny, illuminating him suddenly in the fog. His hands trembled as he raised the shotgun. 'Stop!! Police!!' he shouted, his voice cracking. He fired two shots toward the source of the light. The beam cut out instantly, plunging the area back into darkness.
related_events: Police searchlight turns toward Benny
Benny raises shotgun under searchlight, fearing threat
Benny shouts warning command at perceived threat
Benny fires shots in fear as light remains on him
Police searchlight shuts off after Benny fires

name: Mike Reacts to Benny's Gunfire
description: Mike calls out to Benny, demanding to know what happened. Benny responds that he thinks he shot one of the officers. Mike reacts with shock, exclaiming, 'Jesus, Benny. What are you doing?'
related_events: Mike shouts toward Benny asking what occurred
Benny reports possibly shooting an officer
Mike expresses shock and disbelief at Benny's action

name: Shermin Reports the Encounter to George Fox
description: Shermin steps into the communications room, where technicians are stationed at radar and radio consoles. She orders Lyman to contact Fox. He types a code into a computer, and static flickers across one of the TV screens. The image clears to show George Fox, who looks directly into the camera. Before he can speak, Shermin tells him it's real. Fox asks if there's any mistake, if they could be wrong. Shermin insists there is no error—she saw it herself. She reports that they have killed an extraterrestrial and that another one is still at large. Fox demands the body be removed and flown to Wright Patterson. He says he is going to the White House to secure support. Shermin asks for instructions if they find the second being. Fox tells her to contain it and report back. When she presses for clarification, he repeats his order and then the screen goes dark as Lyman turns it off.
related_events: Shermin enters communications room and reports extraterrestrial encounter
Lyman establishes video connection with George Fox

name: Shermin Reports the Extraterrestrial Encounter to Fox
description: Shermin steps into the communications room and tells Lyman to contact Fox. Lyman types a code, and a television screen flickers to life, showing George Fox staring into the camera. Before Fox can speak, Shermin tells him it's real. Fox asks if there's any chance of a mistake or a hoax. Shermin says there is no mistake—he saw it himself. He adds that another extraterrestrial may be alive somewhere in the area. Fox orders the body to be removed and flown to Wright Patterson Air Force Base. He says he is going to the White House to get support. Shermin asks what to do if they find the other being. Fox tells him to contain it and report back. When Shermin presses for clarification, Fox repeats his order and then the screen goes dark. Lyman turns off the monitor. Major Bell enters the helicopter, and Fox, still stunned, says they will tell the press it was a chemical spill. Bell mentions the need to signal friendliness and asks if anyone is trying to contact the alien ship, but Fox ignores him.
related_events: Shermin enters communications room and reports extraterrestrial encounter
George Fox orders retrieval and transport of extraterrestrial body

name: Fox Orders Body Retrieval and Cover-Up
description: George Fox, speaking through a video feed, orders Shermin to retrieve the extraterrestrial body and load it onto the Air Force helicopter for transport to Wright Patterson. He instructs that the press be told there was a chemical warfare spill, and he demands the cover story be maintained without exception. Major Bell enters the helicopter as Fox ends the transmission, leaving Shermin and the others in silence.
related_events: George Fox orders retrieval and transport of extraterrestrial body
George Fox decides on cover story for extraterrestrial incident
Major Bell enters Air Force chopper

name: Shermin and Bell Ordered to Find Surviving Extraterrestrial
description: George Fox instructed Shermin and Major Bell to begin searching for the surviving extraterrestrial on the ground. As they prepared to move out, Shermin told Fox they would need more help, saying the terrain was vast enough to hide an army. Fox responded that he was going to the White House to secure whatever resources they required. Before the transmission ended, Shermin asked for clarification on what to do if they found the being. Fox told them to contain it and report back. When Shermin pressed for a clearer definition, Fox repeated his order without elaboration. The screen went dark as Lyman turned off the monitor.
related_events: George Fox assigns Shermin and Major Bell to locate ground-based extraterrestrial
Major Bell requests communication with extraterrestrial ship

name: Shermin Seeks Clarification on Containment Orders
description: After receiving orders from George Fox to contain the extraterrestrial, Shermin asks for clarification on what 'contain' means. Fox pauses, then repeats the order without further explanation, instructing Shermin to contain the being and report back. The screen goes static as the transmission ends. Lyman turns off the monitor, and Shermin remains silent, staring at the blank screen.
related_events: Shermin seeks clarification on containment orders
George Fox gives ambiguous containment order

name: Static and Silence
description: The image of George Fox on the television screen dissolved into static. Lyman reached over and switched the screen off.
related_events: Video connection with George Fox terminates in static
Lyman turns off television screen after loss of signal

name: Jenny Confronts Star Man in the Living Room
description: Jenny enters the apartment and locks the door behind her. She walks through the kitchen toward the stairs. As she passes the living room, Star Man steps out from the darkness. Jenny freezes, a scream caught in her throat.
related_events: Jenny enters the apartment and locks the door
Star Man emerges from the darkness in the living room

name: Jenny's Escape Blocked by the Guard Chain
description: Jenny sees the Star Man and immediately runs for the front door. As she dashes down the hallway, her foot catches on a phone cord, yanking the phone from an end table and sending the receiver clattering to the floor. She stumbles but regains her balance and reaches the door just ahead of the Star Man. She grabs the knob and pulls, but the door only opens a few inches before the guard chain stops it. She yanks at it frantically, trying to force it wider, but the chain holds firm. The Star Man reaches the door behind her, slams it shut, and reaches out to grab her.
related_events: Jenny attempts to flee and trips on a phone cord
Jenny reaches the front door but is blocked by the guard chain
Star Man slams the door and attempts to grab Jenny

name: Star Man Pins Jenny Against the Wall
description: Jenny reaches the front door and yanks it open, but the guard chain holds it shut. The Star Man slams the door closed and lunges at her. He presses her back against the wall and covers her mouth with his mitten, stopping her scream. She stops struggling and begins to cry. The Star Man removes his hand from her mouth, holds her gaze, and takes one of her hands in his. He lifts her wrist, peels back a piece of skin, and rolls it between his thumb and forefinger. Jenny lets out a piercing scream and strikes at him. Flashes of light spark from his chest where she hits. The force of her attack shoves him aside, and she runs up the stairs. The Star Man recovers and follows after her.
related_events: Star Man restrains Jenny against the wall
Jenny begins screaming upon seeing Star Man's identification light

name: Jenny Pleads with Star Man
description: Jenny stops struggling and begins to cry. She pleads with the Star Man, begging him not to hurt her. He looks at her, then removes his hand from her mouth.
related_events: Jenny ceases struggling and begins to cry
Jenny pleads with Star Man not to hurt her
Star Man removes his hand from Jenny's mouth

name: Star Man Lifts Jenny's Skin and Is Attacked
description: The Star Man grasps one of Jenny's hands and lifts a piece of skin from her wrist, rolling it between his thumb and forefinger. Jenny lets out a blood-curdling scream, strikes out at him, and hits the panel on his chest. Flashes of light erupt from his exposed chest, and the force of her attack knocks him aside.
related_events: Star Man examines Jenny's wrist by lifting a piece of skin
Jenny screams and strikes Star Man after her skin is lifted
Jenny strikes the panel on Star Man's chest

name: Jenny Flees Upstairs and Star Man Pursues
description: Jenny struck the Star Man with such force that he was knocked aside. She turned and ran up the stairs, disappearing from view. The Star Man steadied himself, then followed, ascending the stairs in pursuit.
related_events: Jenny knocks Star Man aside and flees up the stairs
Star Man recovers and pursues Jenny up the stairs

name: Jenny Barricades the Door and Finds the Gun
description: Jenny reaches the room just ahead of the Star Man, slamming the door shut and locking it before he can get in. He begins pounding on the door as she rushes to the closet, tearing through the side pockets of her jackets and coats in a frantic search. The pounding stops abruptly. The sudden silence makes her turn toward the door, listening. Only the sound of rain breaks the stillness. She keeps searching, her hands moving quickly through the layers of clothing, until she finds the Army-issued .45 in the pocket of a down jacket. She releases the safety, grips the gun tightly, and moves toward the night table where the phone sits.
related_events: Jenny slams and locks the door against the Star Man
Jenny searches closet for hidden firearm
Pounding on the door ceases suddenly

name: Jenny finds the gun and prepares to call for help
description: After the pounding on the door stops, Jenny listens to the silence, then turns back to the closet and continues searching through the pockets of her jackets. She finds an Army-issued .45 in the pocket of a down jacket. She releases the safety and holds the gun tightly, keeping her eyes on the door. She reaches for the phone on the night table and lifts the receiver, but hears only a bleet from the line being off the hook. She hangs up, walks around the bed, and sits on the edge, facing the door. In the distance, a helicopter thumps through the rain. After a moment, she stands, unlocks the door, and peers out. The hallway is empty. She kicks off her shoes and steps out into the hall, the gun in her hand.
related_events: Jenny discovers Army-issued .45 in down jacket pocket
Jenny arms herself and prepares to use the phone

name: Check the disconnected phone and reposition
description: Jenny lifts the phone receiver to her ear, but before it reaches her, she hears a sharp 'BLEET' indicating the phone has been off the hook. She hangs up, walks around the bed, and sits on the corner closest to the door, placing herself where she can see the entrance.
related_events: Jenny hears the phone off the hook and hangs up
Jenny sits on the corner of the bed facing the door

name: Jenny Hears Helicopter and Checks the Hallway
description: Jenny hears the distant thump of an approaching helicopter. She sits on the corner of the bed, listening. After a moment, she gets up and unlocks the door. She waits, then turns the knob and opens it a crack, the gun held ready in her hand. The hallway is empty. She kicks off her shoes and steps out of the bedroom.
related_events: Approaching helicopter is heard in the distance
Jenny unlocks the door after a moment of hesitation
Jenny opens the door a crack with the gun ready

name: Jenny Leaves the Bedroom
description: Jenny kicks off her shoes, turns the knob, and opens the bedroom door a crack. She peers into the hallway, then steps out, closing the door behind her.
related_events: Jenny exits the bedroom after kicking off her shoes

name: The Star Man Watches and Repeats
description: The Star Man stands in the backyard, just beyond the pool of light from the living room window, watching Jenny as she irons clothes and sits before the television. On the screen, a commercial plays: a heavyset man in a jumpsuit smiles and repeats, 'We have... We have automatics... We have sticks... We have colors... We have financing...' The Star Man turns his face toward the window, his expression shifting as he tries the words. 'Wehave...' he says, then again, more clearly, 'Wehave...' and once more, with careful precision, 'Wehave...' Inside, Jenny finishes ironing the skirt, unplugs the iron, gathers the clothes, and turns off the television and the light. She starts up the stairs, then stops. 'Damn!' she says faintly through the glass. She turns back, hesitates, then hurries upward. A light comes on in the bedroom. The Star Man steps back, looking up toward the window, but sees nothing. He moves toward the side door. Before he reaches it, Jenny comes down the stairs in an old sweatshirt, pulling on jeans. She passes through the living room and disappears into the kitchen. Suddenly, the back door swings open. Jenny steps out, grabs the handle of a garbage can, and drags it down the path to the street. When she turns back for the second can, the Star Man is no longer standing in the shadows.
related_events: Star Man observes Jenny from the backyard
Television commercial promotes used cars
Star Man practices human speech sounds

name: Jenny finishes ironing and heads upstairs
description: Jenny finishes ironing her skirt, unplugs the iron, picks up the clothes, turns off the television, and switches off the lights. She starts up the stairs but stops halfway, looks down as if unsure, then turns and continues upstairs. A light comes on in the bedroom.
related_events: Jenny finishes ironing clothes and turns off the television and lights
Jenny stops halfway up the stairs and returns briefly

name: Jenny Returns for Forgotten Item
description: Jenny comes down the stairs in an old sweatshirt, pulling on a pair of jeans. She moves through the house and disappears into the kitchen. Without warning, she rushes out the front door. The Star Man, seeing her approach, steps quickly into the shadows to avoid being seen.
related_events: Jenny comes down the stairs and pulls on jeans
Jenny rushes out of the house and opens the door
Star Man steps into the shadows to avoid being seen

name: Jenny Takes Out the Garbage, Star Man Moves
description: Jenny drags the first garbage can down the path to the street. She turns and walks back toward the house. As she returns for the second can, the Star Man steps out from the shadows where he had been concealed. He moves away, no longer visible in the dim yard.
related_events: Jenny drags first garbage can to the street
Jenny returns to retrieve second garbage can
Star Man leaves his hiding place in the shadows

name: Jenny Turns On the Bedroom Light
description: Jenny enters the bedroom and turns on the light. The room becomes visible from outside. The Star Man, standing in the yard, notices the change and looks up toward the window, but cannot see inside.
related_events: Jenny turns on the bedroom light

name: Benny Searches the House and Sees the Figure
description: Benny moves carefully around the house, flashlight in hand, scanning the area for any sign of movement. He checks an empty doorway framed by bare walls and then approaches a stack of lumber, peering behind it. Finding nothing, he hesitates, then continues onward. A sharp snap cuts through the silence. He freezes. From the darkness, a figure steps forward into the space where Benny had just looked. The figure raises its arms, and with a mechanical motion, cylindrical devices swing from its wrists into its hands.
related_events: Benny discovers empty doorway while circling the house
Benny searches behind stack of lumber and finds nothing
Benny hears a snapping sound and stops while investigating the house
Mysterious figure emerges from darkness and activates wrist-mounted devices

name: Benny Attacked by Flying Light and Injured by Laser Blast
description: A brilliant white light, accompanied by a high-pitched whistle, streaks toward Benny. He fires his shotgun in panic, but the light swerves away. From the light, a laser beam shoots out from a device on a figure’s wrist, striking Benny in the chest. The force knocks him to the ground. Clutching his shoulder, he cries out in pain as the light wobbles erratically between the houses before crashing to the earth.
related_events: Benny is attacked by a flying light emitting a high-pitched whistle
Laser blast from hand rocket strikes Benny and knocks him down

name: Officer Moves to Aid Injured Benny While Mike Calls for Backup
description: After Benny is struck by a laser and cries out in pain, one of the officers tells Mike to call for backup. The officer then shouts to Benny, assuring him that he is coming. Benny, clutching his shoulder, pleads not to be left alone. The officer waves his flashlight beam ahead and begins moving toward Benny, who weakly flashes his own light in response. As they start to approach, the light from the object that attacked Benny wobbles erratically through the air before crashing to the ground ahead of them.
related_events: Mike prepares to investigate after Benny is injured

name: Officers Chase the Fleeing Light Up the Hill
description: Benny and the officer began trotting toward the light where it had crashed to the ground. As they approached, the light suddenly flared to life, emitting a high-pitched whistle as it wobbled erratically and rose back up the hill. The two men broke into a run, chasing after it. The light climbed unevenly through the air until it abruptly lost control, crashing down again and rolling to a stop with its beam shooting straight up. Benny and the officer slowed, their steps faltering as fear took hold, and they hesitated, staring at the still form in the darkness.
related_events: Two men begin to trot toward the light
Light accompanied by high-pitched whistle staggers back up the hill
Light crashes to the earth and lies still with beam pointing upward
Benny and the officer slow their pursuit due to fear

name: Officers Halt as Alien Craft Activates
description: Benny and the officer move toward the fallen light, its beam pointing straight up. Suddenly, a high-pitched whistle cuts through the air from behind. A bright light rockets over their heads. The ground beneath them begins to tremble. Above, at the edge of the forest on the hilltop, a saucer-shaped spacecraft pulses with light as glowing patterns spread across its surface. The two men stop in their tracks, frozen in place.
related_events: High-pitched whistle approaches from behind and light rockets over their heads
Hill begins to vibrate as spacecraft activates

name: UFO Alert: Object Identified as Sea Plane
description: The radar technician shouts a warning as a UFO appears to emerge from the grass. Lyman and the technicians immediately respond, switching the television screens to active scanning modes—microwave scanners, neutron back scatters, and doppler radar. On a fourth screen, the forward-looking infrared module begins forming an image. The tension eases as the object is revealed to be a light sea plane. Lyman mutters that the whole situation is crazy, questioning their readiness if it had truly been an alien craft.

name: Lyman and Major Bell Argue Over Alien Threat
description: After the radar alert turns out to be a light sea plane, Lyman and Major Bell exchange words about the nature of extraterrestrial contact. Bell insists that no one has ever been hurt by an extraterrestrial, mentioning abductions, medical examinations, and even sexual encounters, but maintains that no harm has been proven. Lyman challenges him, pointing out that if someone were killed by aliens, they wouldn’t be able to report it. He argues that the absence of reports doesn’t prove peaceful intentions. The conversation ends without resolution as Shermin moves away to check incoming reports with the technician.

name: The Plaque from the Sky
description: A red dot flickers to life on one of the radar screens. Lyman turns and calls out, 'Fox,' then taps a three-digit code into the console. The screen shifts to show Fox’s face. 'I've got something for you,' Fox says. A new image appears beside him—a thin slab of yellow plastic covered in symbols. Lines of glowing dots form representations of a hydrogen atom, pulsars, a nude man and woman, and Earth’s position in the solar system. Major Bell leans forward. 'It's a copy of the plaque NASA sent into space on the Pioneer probes.' Fox confirms it was found on the extraterrestrial’s suit. Shermin steps closer, eyes fixed on the image. 'Then it's not an accident that they found us.' Fox replies that the plaque might be a point of contact, but Shermin cuts in, 'Not necessarily bad? If they knew we were here, why didn't they let us know they were coming?' Fox holds his gaze. 'We'll get those answers when you find the one you're looking for.' Shermin doesn't move. 'That's not going to happen, George, unless you get us the help you promised us.'

name: Shermin's Worry Amid the Alert
description: Shermin stands behind Lyman and Bell, who are seated in front of a bank of television screens showing live footage of the wooded landscape passing below. He rubs his hands over his face and bends forward to stretch his back. 'Aghh... I'm supposed to umpire a little league game tomorrow,' he says. Lyman replies without looking away from the screens, 'I wouldn't worry about it... There might not be any little league tomorrow.'

name: Shermin Pleads to Expand the Search
description: Fox appears on the screen and announces that the search operation will not be expanded, citing concerns about triggering public panic. Shermin steps forward, urgently appealing to George to go against the decision, stressing that finding the object is essential. Fox responds by assuring the team they will be notified immediately if contact is made with the ship. The transmission ends, leaving the screen filled with static. Lyman reaches over and switches off the television. In the silence that follows, the radar technician mutters that they’re expendable. Shermin looks at him and nods, confirming the truth of the statement.
